title: Tortured Angel Painting
description: A man in a dark jacket stands at a bar counter on the left, looking toward a massive surreal painting that dominates the room. The painting depicts a demonic man in a suit torturing a bloodied, winged female angel with a crown of thorns in a red-lit hallway, with blood dramatically spilling out from the bottom of the canvas onto the floor.
prompt: A man in a dark jacket stands beside a bar counter with a coffee cup and gun, staring at an enormous hyperrealistic painting on the wall. The painting shows a demonic grinning man in a black suit torturing a kneeling, blood-covered female angel with white wings and a crown of thorns in a long red-lit hallway. Blood realistically drips from the bottom edge of the canvas onto the floor, creating a surreal and horrifying scene.
